messages:
jess: Quick check — product wants a smaller scope for the 'efficiency strand' of the Optimize toolkit. Customer asks: batching + KV caching first, quant as optional. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

mike: I'm +1 for batching + cache MVP. Quantization needs infra readiness and e2e evals, not for alpha.

anita: Agree. For pilot we need clear acceptance: 20% token cost reduction in typical customer workload or no-go.

sam: what's the launch criteria for eval-triggered alerts? need threshold definitions.

jess: Proposal: alerts fire when eval regression > 3% F1 on core prompt set or model perplexity increases by 8% across anchor prompts.

mike: Can we make that configurable per-customer? Some customers tolerate more drop for cost saves.

anita: Yes — default thresholds above, but expose in console with per-route overrides. Add guardrail: auto-rollback on >6% regression.

tara: Ops question — does canary rollout ship with caching enabled? we should test KV coherence on canary pool.

deploy-bot: deploy requested by @mike: branch optimize/strand-sprint -> staging

sam: threading back to scope: prioritize batching heuristics (adaptive batch sizing, latency SLOs), KV prefix cache, eval hook + alerting. Quantization as spike for perf team.

jess: Next steps: Mike to draft acceptance criteria doc, Anita to mock console settings, Sam to list eval prompt sets by Friday. Can we aim for pilot in 4 weeks? :calendar:

mike: I can do acceptance doc. Quick Q: do we include smart routing recommendations (cost vs latency) in MVP or wait?

anita: Save smart routing for post-pilot. Keep MVP tightly focused.

jess: Cool. Locking scope: batching + cache + eval alerts. Quant + routing deferred. We'll sync again Tue.

sam: noted. I'll add tickets and label them `optimize/strand-mvp`.
